product.name: Monoprice 40W Wall Mount Music Amplifier with Touchscreen Bluetooth Aux FM and IR Remote
product.description: Experience rich, vibrant audio in any room with the Monoprice 40-Watt Wall Mount Music Amplifier with Touchscreen. Paired with in-wall or in-ceiling speakers (not included), this multi-source music amplifier offers a sleek and unobtrusive audio solution for any space. The amplifier delivers exceptional sound quality through its touchscreen display and features a minimalist decora finish that ensures your sound is heard, not seen. All cables and connections are securely hidden within the walls, eliminating unsightly clutter and tripping hazards.Enjoy your favorite content streamed from any Bluetooth®-enabled device or FM radio station. You can also connect the audio output from your TV, CD, DVD, or Blu-ray player to the line-level AUX input, and play audio files stored on a USB thumb drive or microSD™ card. This amplifier supports a wide range of digital formats, including WAV, MP3, WVA, APE, FLAC, AAC, AIFF, and WMA, ensuring compatibility with your entire music library. With ultralow Total Harmonic Distortion (≤ 0.03% at 1W@1kHz), your audio is delivered with exceptional clarity and precision. The 3" TFT touchscreen offers straightforward and intuitive control over all system functions. Simply touch to operate, or use the included wireless IR remote control. For seamless integration, the system can also be connected to your existing whole-home audio setup via RS 485 connections.   PACKAGE CONTENTS• Wall Mount Music Amplifier • Mounting Trim Panel • 6x Machine Screws • IR Remote Control • User Manual .gte-ctr .row{margin:0;}1 Year Replacement WarrantyMonoprice™ not only stands behind every product we sell with a 1 year replacement warranty, we offer a 30 day money back guarantee as well!
